title: Shipping terms
text: Standard orders ship within 3 business days of confirmation. Tracking is emailed when the carrier collects. Coastal Express delivers within 3 to 5 business days of collection in the western region.

title: Shipping terms
text: If an order has not shipped within 3 business days, customer service confirms the new ship date with the warehouse before replying. We do not promise delivery dates the carrier has not confirmed.

title: Returns and refunds
text: Refunds and credits are approved by the operations manager. Customer service may say a refund request has been logged and will be answered within one business day, but must not promise a refund amount or timing.

title: Returns and refunds
text: Unused goods in original packaging can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full credit. Return shipping is paid by Northwind when the error was ours.

title: Supplier payment policy
text: Supplier invoices are paid on terms when they match the purchase order and the goods receipt. Payments up to USD 2,000 run automatically; larger payments need the owner's approval.

title: Supplier payment policy
text: Preferred suppliers have a 2 percent price variance tolerance against the purchase order. Standard suppliers have none. A duplicate invoice number is always held and never paid twice.

title: Receivables follow-up
text: Overdue customer invoices are followed up at 7, 14 and 30 days past due. Each stage is sent once. Reminders are not sent between 19:00 and 08:00.

title: Receivables follow-up
text: Reminders under USD 2,000 go out automatically. Reminders for larger balances, and any reminder to an account marked sensitive, wait for the owner's approval. Sensitive accounts are handled personally.

title: Voice
text: Write like a person from a small company: short, warm, specific. Use the customer's name and order number. Never apologise twice. Never promise what a record does not show.
